InviteLink.title: InviteLink
InviteLink.description: A customized access link that binds to the first Google account that clicks it.

id.description: The unique identifier of the link.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the link was created.

createdBy.description: User ID/Email of the administrator who created the link.

boundToEmail.description: The Google email address bound to this link after the first login.

boundAt.description: The timestamp when the email address was bound to this link.

status.description: Whether the link is currently active or revoked.

description.description: Optional notes/display name for whom this link was shared with.

/invite_links/{linkId}.description: Stores access token information, used to regulate single-user access via Google Sign-In.
